prompt:

Reference image 2 is official Iconic Ribbit for identity; image 3 is official Uzi for outfit motifs only. POSE — airborne jump toward screen-right: body lifted and leaning slightly forward, front knee raised and rear knee bent, both boots fully visible away from any floor, green hands lifted for balance. Energetic friendly face. No flight powers or jump trail. Approximately square canvas.
Entire single character only, three-quarter facing screen-right, face directed right. Preserve both eyes and both feet, with all anatomy inside the canvas and ample transparent margin on every side. Output one finished sprite, not a sheet or a comparison. Redraw the pose naturally; do not merely rotate or mirror the source.
